title: Cover can be washed, feels uncomfortable.
text:
Cover can be washed, feels uncomfortable.. Baxter lumbar pillow:

The outside material is soft and made well!
There is a strap on both sides to move this around to be comfortable, and there is a outside hidden zipper to take the cover off, and wash this.
The color is brighter in person then shows on my screen! Mine is a brighter red.

That said, this feels hard like I put wood behind me.It’s uncomfortable for me and my husband, and hurts no matter where
We put against our back. Lower, or higher.

I would think if this was taller, and not be so fulled, it might be more comfortable.
